## Summary

The IEEE registry lists one MA-L block to "Dreamtech Co., Ltd" at an address in Jiksan-myeon, Cheonan, South Chungcheong, Korea [1]. Dreamtech Co Ltd, listed on the Korea Exchange as 192650 and based in Bundang, Seongnam, develops and produces mobile phone modules [2], and was founded in 1998, making fingerprint modules and modules for mobile phones, automotive systems and home appliances [3].

No source consulted says what carries this block, and the Cheonan address differs from the Seongnam headquarters given today, so even the identity of this registrant with the listed company is inferred from the name [1][2]. The registry also holds an MA-M block for "DREAMTECH" at a Seongnam address; it is not listed as an alias because no source ties the two registrations together [1].

Products, radios, silicon and FCC grantee codes are not documented by the sources consulted: Dreamtech's own site refused connections and the FCC ID databases refused automated access from this session. Randomization is unknown, and no security advisory was found.
